name: 74HC14
notes: Hex Schmitt-trigger inverter: thresholds near 0.6 and 0.4 of the supply. A resistor from output to input and a capacitor from input to ground oscillate at about 1 / (0.8 R C). Unused inputs must not float.
spice:
.subckt CHIP_74HC14 a1 y1 a2 y2 a3 y3 gnd y4 a4 y5 a5 y6 a6 vcc
Rs vcc gnd 100k
B1 d1 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step((0.5+0.1*(2*v(m1,gnd)/max(v(vcc,gnd),0.1)-1))*v(vcc,gnd)-v(a1,gnd),60)
R1 d1 y1 50
Rm1 d1 m1 1k
Cm1 m1 gnd 1p
B2 d2 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step((0.5+0.1*(2*v(m2,gnd)/max(v(vcc,gnd),0.1)-1))*v(vcc,gnd)-v(a2,gnd),60)
R2 d2 y2 50
Rm2 d2 m2 1k
Cm2 m2 gnd 1p
B3 d3 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step((0.5+0.1*(2*v(m3,gnd)/max(v(vcc,gnd),0.1)-1))*v(vcc,gnd)-v(a3,gnd),60)
R3 d3 y3 50
Rm3 d3 m3 1k
Cm3 m3 gnd 1p
B4 d4 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step((0.5+0.1*(2*v(m4,gnd)/max(v(vcc,gnd),0.1)-1))*v(vcc,gnd)-v(a4,gnd),60)
R4 d4 y4 50
Rm4 d4 m4 1k
Cm4 m4 gnd 1p
B5 d5 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step((0.5+0.1*(2*v(m5,gnd)/max(v(vcc,gnd),0.1)-1))*v(vcc,gnd)-v(a5,gnd),60)
R5 d5 y5 50
Rm5 d5 m5 1k
Cm5 m5 gnd 1p
B6 d6 gnd V = v(vcc,gnd)*lunes_step((0.5+0.1*(2*v(m6,gnd)/max(v(vcc,gnd),0.1)-1))*v(vcc,gnd)-v(a6,gnd),60)
R6 d6 y6 50

Cm6 m6 gnd 1p
.ends CHIP_74HC14
